title: liver_pressure_index: portal pressure and flow indices of haemodynamic load on partial liver grafts
description: Two dimensionless indices of haemodynamic load on a partial liver graft (zP, the portocaval gradient normalised to its physiological value; zF, portal flow per gram relative to the donor), the extraction table of 12 published living donor liver transplantation series (22 groups, 1,026 recipients) with the source of every value, the code that reproduces each plot as a separate file, the perfusion-network model behind the indices, and a browser calculator of small-for-size risk. Research tool, not a medical device.
